lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 distinct high-contrast vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest in the central torso region and narrows progressively toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two anterior-most lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-lateral torso; the two posterior-most lines are similarly short, terminating before the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4 white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, superior to the hind leg joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory with a posterior-lateral spiral from the base, followed by a medial-inward curvature toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.15 times the horizontal width across the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 15-20% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest; dense dark ventral hair fringe; white facial markings including two muzzle spots and a chevron between the eyes; white banding on lower legs.
